race.comment: DEVIL WINGS (1) So You Think gelding from a Snitzel mare on debut for the Hawkes' camp. Has impressed in his two latest trials and makes plenty of appeal in a very thin race. BANNER BANNER (5) comes here with race fitness and experience on his side. Much better effort when he jumped in trip on the home track for a plugging second over 1300m here. Another big run is expected. LANDING GEAR (2) three-year-old Maurice gelding out of the good producing mare Smooth Landing. Has been given plenty of time to develop and all three trials had merit. Has the ability to overcome the awkward gate. STUNNING FUTURE (9) resumes from a lengthy spell. Bumped into a couple of handy types in her two career starts last March. Wasn't pushed out in the two trials and drawn to get the right run. Keep safe.
